question.text: The formation of molecular complex $\mathrm{BF}_3-\mathrm{NH}_3$ results in a change in hybridization of boron

solution.text: $\operatorname{In~} \mathrm{BF}_3, \mathrm{~B}$ is $s p^2$ hybridized with one empty $p_{\mathrm{z}}$ orbital. The empty $p_{\mathrm{z}}$ orbital of $\mathrm{BF}_3$ can be filled by lone pair of molecules such as $\mathrm{NH}_3$. When this occurs a tetrahedral molecule or ion is formed which is $s p^3$ hybridized.
